# GENERATED by tools/gen.py from tools/inline_editor/common/scripted_effects/rn_inline_cooldown.txt - edit the source.
# Rename Anything in-place editor (iteration 3): rename cooldown, per target type (country+adjective,
# leader, ruling party), stored on the own COUNTRY as an expiry day number (global.num_days based,
# vanilla pattern ENG/GER ai_strategy and 00_on_actions FRA_capitulation_days). Country variables
# are saved with the game. Started ONLY from the successful branch of each guarded Apply.
# Time only advances while the game is unpaused.

# Cooldown length in game days, the single source for every rename type (the state/city cooldown
# rn_cd_days reads it too). The lobby rule rn_rename_cooldown picks it; its default option is
# COOLDOWN_DAYS of tools/gen.py (Workshop request 2026-10-25). 0 days: a rename never blocks the next.
rn_ip_cooldown_days = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_rename_cooldown option = RN_COOLDOWN_OFF } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_days = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_rename_cooldown option = RN_COOLDOWN_1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_days = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_rename_cooldown option = RN_COOLDOWN_15 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_days = 15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = rn_rename_cooldown option = RN_COOLDOWN_30 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_days = 30 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { rn_ip_cd_days = 5 }
	}
}

rn_ip_cooldown_start_country = {
	rn_ip_cooldown_days = yes
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_country_until = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { rn_ip_cd_country_until = temp_var:rn_ip_cd_days }
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_country_date = global.date }
}

rn_ip_cooldown_start_leader = {
	rn_ip_cooldown_days = yes
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_leader_until = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { rn_ip_cd_leader_until = temp_var:rn_ip_cd_days }
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_leader_date = global.date }
}

rn_ip_cooldown_start_party = {
	rn_ip_cooldown_days = yes
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_party_until = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { rn_ip_cd_party_until = temp_var:rn_ip_cd_days }
	set_variable = { rn_ip_cd_party_date = global.date }
}
